spec2def(main.cpl main.spec)

set(ICONS_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../win32/shell32/res/icons)
file(GLOB main_rc_deps resources/*.* ${ICONS_DIR}/38.ico ${ICONS_DIR}/39.ico)
add_rc_deps(main.rc ${main_rc_deps})

# main.cpl is all Rust (main-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/main-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# keyboard.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/main-rust/src/main/keyboard.rs)
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/main-rust/src/main/main.rs)
# mouse.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/main-rust/src/main/mouse.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(main_res OBJECT main.rc)
target_compile_definitions(main_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(main_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(MAIN_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/uuid/libuuid.a)
add_cargo_module(main main-cargo main.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE main-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS main_res ${MAIN_REUSED})
